mapper.sql: pc.id AS assignment_id, c.id AS character_id, pc.project_id, c.workspace_id, c.canonical_name, c.aliases::text AS aliases_json, pc.project_aliases::text AS project_aliases_json, pc.role, pc.importance, pc.groups_json::text AS groups_json, pc.pinned_character_version_id, pc.status, COALESCE(scene_usage.scene_count, 0)::int AS scene_count, pc.row_version, pc.created_at, pc.updated_at, cv.version_number, cv.status AS version_status, cv.bible, cv.visual_prompt, appearance.age_state, appearance.hairstyle, appearance.injury, appearance.wardrobe_context, appearance.appearance_prompt

FROM project_characters pc JOIN projects p ON p.id = pc.project_id JOIN characters c ON c.id = pc.character_id LEFT JOIN character_versions cv ON cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.scene_id) AS scene_count FROM scene_characters sc WHERE sc.project_character_id = pc.id ) scene_usage ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ca.age_state, ca.hairstyle, ca.injury, ca.wardrobe_context, ca.appearance_prompt FROM character_appearances ca WHERE ca.character_id = c.id AND (ca.project_id = pc.project_id OR ca.project_id IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ca.project_id = pc.project_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ca.updated_at DESC, ca.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) appearance ON TRUE
